$comment: Every Microsoft-side resource three.ws needs, derived from the code that uses it. scripts/microsoft-provision.mjs reconciles a tenant and subscription to this file; tests/microsoft-provision.test.js fails when code asks Microsoft for a scope, redirect URI, token audience or MS_* identity variable that is not listed here. Docs: integrations/microsoft/provisioning/README.md.

graph.permissionIdSource: Microsoft Graph service principal servicePrincipals(appId='00000003-0000-0000-c000-000000000000'): oauth2PermissionScopes for delegated (Scope), appRoles for application (Role). Cross-checked 2026-11-16 against the Identifier column of microsoftgraph/microsoft-graph-docs-contrib concepts/permissions-reference.md. The provisioner re-resolves every id live from the service principal on each run and refuses to apply when one differs.

apps.purpose: Publisher app for the SaaS Fulfillment API v2, the Marketplace Metering API and Partner Center insights. Its tenant id and app id go into Partner Center technical configuration.

tokenAudiences.note: Microsoft Marketplace first-party app (MARKETPLACE_APP_ID). Needs no API permission on the app registration.
Authorized in Partner Center (Account settings > User management > Microsoft Entra applications, Manager role), not by an API permission.

manualSteps: Partner Center > Marketplace offers > three-ws > Technical configuration: Microsoft Entra tenant ID = MS_MARKETPLACE_TENANT_ID, Microsoft Entra application ID = MS_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID.
Partner Center > Account settings > User management > Microsoft Entra applications: add MS_MARKETPLACE_CLIENT_ID with the Manager role (Partner Center insights).

apps.purpose: Multitenant app: Marketplace buyer sign-in, Sign in with Microsoft on /login (work, school and personal accounts through the common authority), tenant claim for teams, and the Microsoft 365 Copilot connector after a tenant admin consents.

tokenAudiences.via: client_credentials scope https://graph.microsoft.com/.default in each consenting tenant
tokenAudiences.note: Grants the two Role permissions above once a tenant admin consents.

adminConsent.note: Customer tenants consent through Settings > Microsoft 365 (GET /api/microsoft-365/connect/start), which adds the state the callback checks. The printed URL is for a tenant admin who wants to pre-consent outside that flow.

apps.purpose: Identity of the Azure Bot. Inbound Teams and Microsoft 365 activities carry a Bot Framework token whose audience is this app id; proactive sends (Adaptive Card universal actions, Teams notifications) mint a Bot Framework token with this app's secret.

tokenAudiences.via: client_credentials scope https://graph.microsoft.com/.default in the recipient's tenant
tokenAudiences.note: Grants TeamsActivity.Send once that tenant's admin consents; sendActivityNotification fails with 403 until then.

tokenAudiences.via: client_credentials scope https://api.botframework.com/.default from the bot's tenant
tokenAudiences.note: Bot Framework connector; no API permission on the app registration.

channels.name: MsTeamsChannel
channels.purpose: Microsoft Teams personal, group chat and channel scopes plus the Agents message extension.

channels.name: M365Extensions
channels.purpose: Microsoft 365 channel: the message extension and agent in Outlook and the Microsoft 365 app.

vaults.purpose: three.ws's own Microsoft client secrets, mirrored from the env vars. Only the signed-in operator can read it.
The pre-registered three.ws OAuth client Microsoft 365 Copilot uses for the remote MCP agent connector. A separate vault so Microsoft's reader role never reaches the ops secrets.

unmanaged.MS_MARKETPLACE_LEADS_TOKEN: three.ws-generated shared secret for the Partner Center leads webhook; not a Microsoft resource.
unmanaged.MS_MARKETPLACE_API_BASE: Fulfillment API base override for the local SaaS emulator; production uses the Microsoft default.
unmanaged.MS_MARKETPLACE_METERING_BASE: Metering API base override for the local SaaS emulator; production uses the Microsoft default.
unmanaged.MS_MARKETPLACE_TOKEN_URL: Publisher token endpoint override for the local SaaS emulator; production derives it from MS_MARKETPLACE_TENANT_ID.
unmanaged.MS_MARKETPLACE_EMULATOR: Local development flag that points the Marketplace integration at Microsoft's SaaS API emulator.
unmanaged.MS_MARKETPLACE_EMULATOR_LOGIN_BASE: Sign-in base for the local SaaS emulator.
unmanaged.MS_APP_ID: App GUID Partner Center assigns to the Microsoft 365 app offer; created in Partner Center, not Entra.
unmanaged.MS_DEVELOPER_NAME: Legal entity name for the app package.
unmanaged.MS_STORE_APP_NAME: Microsoft Store product identity from Partner Center.
unmanaged.MS_STORE_PACKAGE_ID: Microsoft Store product identity from Partner Center.
unmanaged.MS_STORE_PUBLISHER_CN: Microsoft Store product identity from Partner Center.
unmanaged.MS_STORE_PUBLISHER_DISPLAY_NAME: Microsoft Store product identity from Partner Center.

excluded.reason: Signs users in with three.ws's own OAuth server (integrations/microsoft/power-platform-connector/apiProperties.template.json, identityProvider oauth2generic), so it needs a three.ws public PKCE client, not an Entra app.

No Teams SSO: the manifest's webApplicationInfo only names the bot app so activity feed notifications can be sent, and the tab uses three.ws sessions. Resource-specific consent permissions live in the Teams app manifest, not on an app registration.
